items.label: Stylish V-Neck Design
items.value: The V-neckline is a classic and elegant choice, suitable for both dressy and casual occasions. It adds sophistication to outfit, whether you're heading to a business meeting or a casual brunch

items.label: Long Sleeve for Cozy Warmth
items.value: The long sleeves provide ample coverage and warmth in fall. They fit comfortably without being tight, adding a stylish touch to your look

items.label: Loose Fit for Comfort and Versatility
items.value: The loose fit ensures comfort and ease of movement, suitable for various body types. It gives the sweater a casual vibe and makes it versatile for dressing up or down

items.label: Soft and Comfortable Fabrics
items.value: Made with lightweight and breathable materials, this sweater offers comfort and ease of movement

items.label: Versatile Dressy and Casual Wear
items.value: This sweater is versatile. It can be dressed up with a skirt and heels or paired with jeans and boots. Its V-neck, long sleeves, and loose fit make it ideal for various occasion
